[Convex displacement function] 1. Lemma 4.9.1\group foliations Source: thurston:page-0076, thurston:page-0077 For orientation-preserving hyperbolic isometries $g_1,g_2$, the function $x\mapsto \dist (g_1x,g_2x)$ on $\HH ^2$ is convex.
